rust_workspace.scope: All non-host-launcher workspace library and integration tests. The ignored Linux MPRIS test was run separately on an isolated bus.

final_podcast_command_tests.scope: Final async navigation guard adds two cases after the broad run; four cases overlap the broad run. Totals are not added.

javascript.scope: Simulated browser/host and service-worker boundaries; no device permissions, external messages or audio playback.

compile.scope: Host-target checking. Browser WebAssembly compilation and full native OS links belong to GitHub Actions.

isolated_mpris.scope: Real private TCP D-Bus discovery/properties/controls/seek/volume/teardown, no desktop session or physical media keys.

windows_adapter.scope: Exact media-session adapter source type-checked with pinned Windows bindings in a minimal x86_64-pc-windows-gnu harness; not a complete Windows executable build.

limits: The local Linux camera portal/provider is unavailable in this environment.
No physical camera/audio/codec or OS consent/notification behavior is certified by these checks.
No original-device pixel or motion parity claim follows from these tests.
